# U136: Change a goal is one page: an old “?part=plan” link lands on Plan and target; the four sections in order, each with its anchor; one way out, “Close and keep the draft”, which keeps a changed target for next time; Save changes stays at the foot and never covers the reason box; Save with a question open focuses the question, in view, and says where it is (900 hours on Lead time, better lower, asks wrong-side); #owner opens at Who and where, its owner found by typing

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `GOAL-EDIT-PAGE`, `NAV-FORMS`, `PLAN-CHANGE`, `FIND-AND-PICK`
- **Budget:** at most 6 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `/goals/ns-lead/edit?part=plan` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, line 5824

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- _Note:_ An old link to one part of the form lands on that section of the one page, and the address says so.
- Go to `/goals/ns-lead/edit?part=plan` in the demo.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/ns-lead/edit?today=…#plan”.
- **Check:** “Change Lead time for changes” is shown.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Plan and target” heading is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Check:** It fails if the sections read {heads.join(', ')}.
- _Note:_ One way out, in words; no second exit.
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if the edit page has {exits} ways out.
- **Check:** “Check-ins have started, so a change here needs a reason. Watchers see it flagged.” is shown.
- _Note:_ A new target asks why; Save changes is in view at the foot and the reason box, focused, is not under it.
- **Step.** Type “20” into the “Target” field.
- Move the focus to the “Why change it?” field.
- **Check:** (`progress`) it fails if the reason box ({rb && Math.round(rb.y + rb.height)}) is under Save changes ({fb && Math.round(fb.y)}), or the bar is off the screen.
- **Check:** (`progress`) the “Save changes” button is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “plan”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Save with a question open, maybe out of sight: focus goes to the first question, which comes into view, and the line above Save says where it is, as New goal's Continue does (GE2 review). 900 hours is far outside the plan.
- Type “900” into the “Target” field.
- Type “Moving to the new dashboard” into the “Why change it?” field.
- Press the “Save changes” button.
- **Check:** (`errors`) it fails if Save with a question open says “{said}”, with focus {a value worked out in the journey}.
- **Check:** (`logged`) it fails if Save with a question open saved.
- _Note:_ Lead time for changes is better lower: what measures the goal now asks the wrong-side question here too.
- **Check:** (`errors`) the words ““Lead time for changes” is better lower, but the target (900 hours) is above today” is visible (else: a target above today on a lower-is-better metric is not asked about).
- _Note:_ "No, I'll change the numbers" goes back to the field, as on New goal.
- Press the “No, I’ll change the numbers” button.
- **Check:** (`errors`) it fails if “No, I’ll change the numbers” does not go back to Target.
- Type “20” into the “Target” field.
- _Note:_ Closing keeps the draft: back on the goal, nothing saved; opened again, the new target is there.
- **Step.** Press the “Close and keep the draft” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/ns-lead”.
- **Check:** (`logged`) it fails if closing saved the change.
- Go to the address “{url('/goals/ns-lead/edit')}#owner”.
- **Check:** “Restored your unsaved edits” is shown (else: closing did not keep the draft).
- **Check:** (`finish`) it fails if the kept draft lost the new target.
- _Note:_ #owner opens at Who and where; its owner is a find-and-pick, not a list.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Who and where” heading is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Check:** (`errors`) the “Owner: Rhea Kapoor. Change” button is visible and the “Feeds into” button is visible (else: the owner or Feeds into is not a find-and-pick).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “owner”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- Close this browser.
